name: How To Act
overview: Scripture instructs believers on how to act by emphasizing righteous living rooted in God's guidance and love. From training children in the right way to walking humbly with God while doing justice and loving mercy, the Bible calls for a life marked by godly character and humility. Believers are also reminded not to judge others harshly but to trust in God's sovereign plan, which works all things for good for those who love Him. Ultimately, acting rightly flows from faith in Christ, who offers eternal life to all who believe.
